cohort: 35 preterm infants born at 32 weeks gestation or earlier were included in the study.
finding: The primary finding was that cerebral oxygen saturation (rSO2) values significantly increased during and after Kangaroo Care for both mothers and fathers, with maternal KC showing significantly higher rSO2 values, though this difference was considered clinically ignorable as all values remained within normal limits.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at the postnatal 35th week of gestation during three periods: in the incubator before KC, during KC with the mother or father, and in the incubator after KC.
